prompt: Write to a walking-group organizer suggesting a route with more benches. Frame the suggestion around making the outing comfortable for a wider range of participants. Use approximately 80 words for the response.
text:
Hi [Organizer’s Name],

Thanks for organizing our group walks! Could we consider a route with more benches or regular places to sit? Having opportunities to pause could make the outing more comfortable for a wider range of participants, including anyone managing fatigue, recovering from an injury, or simply preferring a gentler pace. A park loop with seating might work well, allowing people to rest and rejoin easily. I’d be happy to help find a suitable route.

Best,
[Your Name]
